scenario_description: A real behavior mismatch remains failed evidence and stops the experiment.
expected: The mismatch has a nonzero exit status and retains its diagnostic stderr.
The sentinel command after the failure is explicitly recorded as not run.
Host source remains unchanged and the disposable container is removed.
observed: The deliberately wrong expectation exited 1 and retained AssertionError: expected 999, got 6 in stderr.
The following sentinel command appears in not_run_command_ids and has no fabricated execution result.
The host snapshot SHA-256 remained identical with no changed paths and no container existed after stop.
notes: Manually inspected the negative command boundary, diagnostic output, stop-on-failure behavior, host hashes, and container cleanup in the retained probe.
